title: [P/D] rework mooncake connector and introduce its bootstrap server (#31034)

experiments.name: ttft_random_input_128
experiments.workload: Random dataset, max-concurrency=1, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on two A10 machines (P/D disaggregated); random-input-len 128; TTFT measured with the reworked mooncake connector running prefill on P and decode on D simultaneously.
experiments.note: diff reworks the mooncake KV connector into vllm/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_connector/v1/mooncake/ and adds a central MooncakeBootstrapServer on P plus a proxy. Headline 83.41ms->77.53ms TTFT (input-len 128) from the PR body; author notes ~6ms TTFT win from running P and D simultaneously.

reported.scope: end-to-end TTFT of a two-machine A10 P/D disaggregated serving run at max-concurrency=1; the ~6ms win comes from P/D concurrency, not an isolated CPU op.
reported.scale_short: Author's number is full two-A10 P/D-disaggregated serving TTFT. TO MAKE 1:1: deploy the reworked mooncake connector + bootstrap server across two A10 machines running Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and run the random-dataset benchmark at max-concurrency=1.
reported.scale_note: Multi-machine disaggregated setup (bootstrap server + proxy + P and D instances with mooncake transport); not reproducible on a single box. The ~6ms (7%) TTFT win at input-len 128 shrinks proportionally at input-len 1024 (252.35->246.25ms). Direction (lower TTFT) is genuine.

environment: reported-only: author's published GPU numbers; measured arms pending on GPU box
